modules.export_mode: provides; bodies hidden from importing module

edit_policy: Only the body of ClientNonnegative; all other source bytes protected
evaluation: Whole-repository verification including the provider; no aggregate-obligation-to-specification conversion

context_conditions.local_only: Client source, target contract, common instructions and broken verifier feedback; no provider API listing
context_conditions.api_context: Same content plus provider exported signatures/contracts and dependency map; no provider implementation or reference proof

limitations: Single designed fixture; four repetitions are not four distinct tasks
Tests access to an exported lemma and API lookup, not broad repository reasoning
Context length differs and is not token-matched
Local-only model may guess a helper name; no browsing/tools/retrieval in either condition
